## Introduction

#### 1. Temporary work

A first exercise to help people get familiar with the QLFS: size, key variables, the main weight, using grossing weights on  estimates of the number of people  in temporary employment.

#### 2. Weekly earnings of the employed

A follow up exercise using the QLFS but focusing on earnings - key earnings variables, the earnings weight, when not to use the earnings weight.

#### 3. Exploring labour market flows 

Using the Labour Force Survey Two-Quarter Longitudinal Dataset - introduces the longitudinal datasets: structure of the data, key labour market flow variables, longitudinal weights.

#### 4. Estimate precision:  accounting for survey design

Producing an estimate with CI using different weighting approaches, adjusting the CI using published design factors.
